alerts.title: Possible ransomware staging — mass file rename on FILESRV-AU02
alerts.description: **CrowdStrike** detected **>4,000 file renames** with the appended extension `.0rgn` on **FILESRV-AU02** within *90 seconds*, initiated by `svchost.exe` spawned from an *unsigned binary* in `C:\PerfLogs\`. Shadow-copy deletion was attempted but **blocked**.

alerts.title: OAuth consent grant to unverified app for 3 privileged users
alerts.description: **Defender XDR** fired after an *unverified* multi-tenant application was granted `Mail.ReadWrite` and `offline_access` by **three privileged users** within *11 minutes*.

alerts.title: Impossible travel: AU → RO sign-in, MFA fatigue pattern
alerts.description: Microsoft sign-in telemetry shows a successful **AU** login followed by *repeated MFA prompts* and a **Romania** login attempt from a *new device fingerprint* — a classic **MFA-fatigue** pattern.

alerts.title: Outbound beaconing to rare domain from OT jump host
alerts.description: **Splunk ES** detected *periodic* outbound TLS traffic from the **OT jump host** to a *rare domain* with **no prior enterprise reputation** — consistent with C2 beaconing.

alerts.title: Credential-phish campaign targeting retail billing team (38 rcpts)
alerts.description: **Proofpoint** identified a *credential-harvesting* campaign impersonating the **retail billing portal**, delivered to **38 recipients**.

alerts.title: New local admin created outside change window — WKS-4471
alerts.description: A *local administrator* account was created on **WKS-4471** **outside** the approved change window and *without* a matching service-desk ticket.

alerts.title: MISP IOC match: known C2 IP touched perimeter (blocked)
alerts.description: **MISP** matched a *known* command-and-control IP in **blocked** perimeter traffic. *No successful session* was observed.

alerts.title: Unusual volume of DNS TXT queries from CI runner pool
alerts.description: DNS telemetry shows *elevated* **TXT** query volume from **CI runners**, including repeated lookups for *encoded subdomains* — possible **DNS tunnelling**.

alerts.title: EDR sensor offline > 72h on 6 corporate laptops
alerts.description: **CrowdStrike** reports **six** corporate laptops have not checked in for *more than 72 hours* and are missing current *sensor-health* data.

alerts.title: TLS certificate for partner API expires in 9 days
alerts.description: Certificate monitoring reports the **partner API** TLS certificate expires in *9 days* with **no replacement** certificate observed.

alerts.title: Bulk OneDrive download to unapproved file-sharing service
alerts.description: **Netskope CASB** flagged **~4.2 GB** moved from *OneDrive* to `tempfileshare[.]io` over a *45-minute* window by `marcus.johnson@example.com`. Files carried **PII** and **Financial** sensitivity labels; the transfer occurred from an *unmanaged device*.
